messages:
harry (CS): drafting a short 'rapid stabilize' playbook for customers showing signs of renewal risk. need a punchy 15-min walkthrough + checklist (cache/batch/stream) we can reuse. quick eyes?

meera (ENG): happy to. keep it checklist-first — sales/customer can run steps without heavy ENG time. include a tiny runtime snippet and a pre-warm template.

pat (CS Ops): add concrete numbers for the warm-run so CS can execute: prefill top-6 prompts at 8 qps for 30s, then warm-run 120 synthetic requests at 2 qps for 3 minutes. capture lat_p50, lat_p95, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_req, error_rate.

jo (DE): UX suggestion: 1-line decision header at top: "If cache_hit_rate < 20% -> enable client prefill; if tokens_per_req > 350 -> trim context or request quantized model." keeps it scannable.

meera (ENG): runtime snippet to paste on page: ```
# recommended field runtime (small/med)
cache_enabled: true
cache_prefix_ttl_ms: 25000
batching:
  max_batch: 12
  timeout_ms: 10
streaming: true
# lower max_batch for interactive widgets
```

harry (CS): love it. draft 15-min script below — short and repeatable:
- 0:00-1:00: intro + outcome (reduce p95 & stabilize cost)
- 1:00-5:00: demo cold vs warmed cache (show latency + token counts)
- 5:00-8:00: run pre-warm template live (or show example results)
- 8:00-11:00: review telemetry snapshot and flag risk signals
- 11:00-14:00: agree mitigations (enable streaming, reduce batch timeout, prefill)
- 14:00-15:00: assign eng owner + next-check-in time

pat (CS Ops): quick troubleshooting matrix for the one-pager: "p95 > 1s -> decrease batch timeout or enable streaming; cache_hit_rate < 10% -> inspect prompt variability + enable client-side prefill; sustained errors -> capture 3 sample req/resp + escalate to eng-oncall."

infra-bot: reminder: attach last-10 warm-run traces to the tenant ticket before scheduling the call.

meera (ENG): safe rollback line: flip routing to fallback-model=quantized-small for 12-24h while investigating; monitor cache_hit_rate and lat_p95 during rollback.

harry (CS): i'll produce a printable one-pager (checkboxes: pre-warm done, traces attached, telemetry snapshot, mitigation chosen, eng owner) and post to the ticket. will share PDF in #cs when ready. thanks team. :thumbsup:
